Aerial Ace.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

Baton Pass.desc: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

Belly Drum.desc: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.

Brick Break.desc: Destroys screens, even if the target is immune.

Bulk Up.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

Calm Mind.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.

Counter.desc: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.

Crunch.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Curse.desc: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.

Destiny Bond.desc: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.

Dragon Dance.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.

Earthquake.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Power doubles on Dig.

Encore.desc: The target repeats its last move for 3-6 turns.

Endeavor.desc: Lowers the target's HP to the user's HP.

Endure.desc: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

Explosion.desc: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.

Fake Tears.desc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

Flail.desc: More power the less HP the user has left.

Focus Punch.desc: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.

Giga Drain.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

Heal Bell.desc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

Hidden Power Bug.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Bug on this set.

Hidden Power Fire.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Fire on this set.

Hidden Power Flying.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Flying on this set.

Hidden Power Ghost.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Ghost on this set.

Hidden Power Grass.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Grass on this set.

Hidden Power Ground.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Ground on this set.

Hidden Power Ice.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Ice on this set.

Hidden Power Rock.desc: Type set by the user's IVs: Rock on this set.

Hypnosis.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Imprison.desc: No foe can use any move known by the user.

Iron Tail.desc: 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

Knock Off.desc: Target's item is lost and it cannot obtain another.

Leech Seed.desc: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.

Lovely Kiss.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Mean Look.desc: Prevents the target from switching out.

Meteor Mash.desc: 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

Milk Drink.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

Mirror Coat.desc: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.

Overheat.desc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

Pain Split.desc: Shares HP of user and target equally.

Perish Song.desc: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.

Protect.desc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

Psych Up.desc: Copies the target's current stat stages.

Psychic.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Pursuit.desc: Power doubles if the targeted foe is switching out.

Rain Dance.desc: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

Rapid Spin.desc: Frees user from hazards, binding, Leech Seed.

Razor Leaf.desc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.

Recover.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

Refresh.desc: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.

Rest.desc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

Reversal.desc: More power the less HP the user has left.

Roar.desc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

Rock Slide.desc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

Seismic Toss.desc: Does damage equal to the user's level.

Self-Destruct.desc: Target's Def halved during damage. User faints.

Shadow Ball.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Silver Wind.desc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

Sky Uppercut.desc: Can hit Pokemon using Bounce or Fly.

Slack Off.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

Sleep Powder.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Sleep Talk.desc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

Soft-Boiled.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

Solar Beam.desc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

Spikes.desc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

Spore.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Steel Wing.desc: 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

Substitute.desc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

Sunny Day.desc: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

Superpower.desc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

Surf.desc: Hits foes. Power doubles against Dive.

Synthesis.desc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

Taunt.desc: For 2 turns, the target can't use status moves.

Thief.desc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

Trick.desc: User switches its held item with the target's.

Wish.desc: Next turn, heals 50% of the recipient's max HP.

items.Choice Band: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
items.Leftovers: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.
items.Liechi Berry: Raises holder's Attack by 1 stage when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.
items.Petaya Berry: Raises holder's Sp. Atk by 1 stage when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.
items.Salac Berry: Raises holder's Speed by 1 stage when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.
items.Thick Club: If held by a Cubone or a Marowak, its Attack is doubled.

abilities.Arena Trap: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.
abilities.Battle Armor: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
abilities.Blaze: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Fire-type attacks have 1.5x power.
abilities.Chlorophyll: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
abilities.Clear Body: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
abilities.Cloud Nine: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
abilities.Effect Spore: 10% chance of poison/paralysis/sleep on others making contact with this Pokemon.
abilities.Flash Fire: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5x damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.
abilities.Guts: If this Pokemon is statused, its Attack is 1.5x; ignores burn halving physical damage.
abilities.Hyper Cutter: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.
abilities.Immunity: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.
abilities.Inner Focus: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch.
abilities.Intimidate: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.
abilities.Keen Eye: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage.
abilities.Levitate: This Pokemon is immune to Ground.
abilities.Lightning Rod: This Pokemon draws single-target Electric moves used by opponents to itself.
abilities.Magma Armor: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.
abilities.Magnet Pull: Prevents Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, other than this Pokemon.
abilities.Marvel Scale: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.Natural Cure: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
abilities.Oblivious: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated. Gaining this Ability while infatuated cures it.
abilities.Overgrow: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Grass-type attacks have 1.5x power.
abilities.Pressure: If this Pokemon is the target of a move, that move loses one additional PP.
abilities.Rain Dish: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
abilities.Rock Head: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle and crash damage.
abilities.Sand Stream: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.
abilities.Serene Grace: This Pokemon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled.
abilities.Shell Armor: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
abilities.Static: 1/3 chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.
abilities.Sturdy: OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.
abilities.Swarm: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Bug-type attacks have 1.5x power.
abilities.Swift Swim: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.
abilities.Synchronize: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes this Pokemon, it also gets that status.
abilities.Thick Fat: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved Sp. Atk stat.
abilities.Torrent: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's Water-type attacks have 1.5x power.
abilities.Trace: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.
abilities.Truant: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
abilities.Volt Absorb: This Pokemon heals 1/4 its max HP when hit by a damaging Electric move; immunity.
abilities.Water Absorb: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.
